data.name: Naryan
data.long_meaning: The name Naryan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Narayana', which means 'Lord', 'Master', or 'Ruler'. In Hinduism, Narayana is a popular name for Vishnu, the preserver of the universe. The name is believed to bestow strength, courage, and victory upon the bearer.

in_sanskrit.name: नर्यान
in_sanskrit.meaning: Lord of Men, Man-god, God of Men
